title: Explicit pasted localized underived counit
statement: For scheme morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z and a homotopy complex K on X, define the explicit morphism from Lf Lg Q(Ug Uf K) to QK to be Lf(epsilon(g) at Ug Uf K followed by Q of the underived g-counit at Uf K), followed by epsilon(f) at Uf K and Q of the underived f-counit at K. The counits and adjunctions are the already selected data of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] and [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. This is a concrete composition, not an existentially chosen object.

source.place: Tags 079W, 0D5S and 0D5T: explicit counit composition used in the parent normalization.

proof_origin.note: Concrete construction; construction equation is reflexivity. Naming this morphism avoids repeated elaboration of the selected counit data.

def derivedCompositionCounitApex
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    (derivedPullback g ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj
      (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K))) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K
